gaps.whyImportant: Major high-altitude world landscape gap for ERN with exceptional visual value and low representation from Central Asia.
researchEvidence: Official Tajikistan tourism material confirms the Pamir Highway as a major high-altitude route through Gorno-Badakhshan and the Pamir landscape.
Official Khorugh city site confirms Khorugh as the administrative center of GBAO in the Pamir region.
Current web research found travel videos and webcam directories, but no sufficiently trustworthy always-current live camera source for ERN promotion.
disallowedShortcuts: Do not use prerecorded YouTube travel films as LIVE.
Do not infer live status from generic Tajikistan webcam directories.
Do not promote a weather iframe as a scenic live camera without source-specific moving/current imagery.
nextResearch: Check Pamir tourism authority, GBAO local government, Khorugh municipality, Murghab operators, border-road/weather stations and resort/guesthouse camera pages.
Prefer Khorog, Murghab, Karakul Lake or Wakhan Valley if an official or operator-published current camera emerges.
